theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [Finite ι] {s : ι → Set α} (hs : Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint s)) : (⋃ i, s i).encard = ∑ᶠ (i : ι), (s i).encard := by
  have h_nonempty : ∀ i, (s i).Nonempty := by intro i; exact Set.Nonempty.intro ⟨⟩
  have h_injective : Function.Injective fun s => ⋃ i ∈ s, s i :=
    Pairwise.biUnion_injective hs h_nonempty
  have h_sigma_set : Set.range ⇑(Function.Embedding.sigmaSet hs) = ⋃ i, s i :=
    Function.Embedding.sigmaSet_range hs
  rw [h_sigma_set]
  apply encard_sigma_set
  exact hs
